notes: Cets is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 CETS once to msg.sender. No application contracts or initialization calls are needed. initialPrice records floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), with CETS as currency0 and the paired token as currency1, for provenance only. The deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the actual currency ordering.
